title: GCS service_account_key inline JSON not validated at config time
description: When service_account_key is set to a literal JSON string (not a secretx:// URI), the config validator does not check that the value is valid JSON, or that it contains the required fields for a GCS service account key (type, project_id, private_key_id, private_key, client_email). A malformed key value will pass config validation and only fail at runtime when the GCS builder tries to parse it — producing a confusing late error. Since the key can be multi-line (base64 private key), operator typos are likely. A simple serde_json::from_str check at validation time would catch this early.
